name: tpl-precedence-4-goal
task: Reach the exit, but you must have flipped the switch first.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task says you must have flipped the switch first, but the only clause is Existence(at_exit), which lets the agent reach the exit without ever toggling the switch. Add a hard Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit); together with the hard Existence(at_exit) it also forces the toggle, so no Existence(switch_toggled) is needed.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires the exit and Precedence(switch_toggled, at_exit) forbids reaching it before the switch was flipped, which together force the switch to be flipped first. No Existence(switch_toggled) is needed since the order clause with the hard goal already forces it.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled) -> u3
(u1, at_exit) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&switch_toggled, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_exit&!switch_toggled, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_exit&switch_toggled, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_exit, u3) -> 11
